title: Amretri Healthcare
tagline: Transforming Hospital Pharmacy Operations Across India
summary: Enterprise healthcare platform engineered to manage hospital pharmacies, bulk medicine procurement, and pharmacist supply — featuring the AMRI AI assistant with automated Google Sheets lead sync and instant WhatsApp routing.
description: Amretri Healthcare is a Pan-India healthcare operations leader helping hospitals achieve 5–30% margin uplift through pharmacy management, staffing, and bulk medicine supply. They needed a premier digital platform matching their enterprise caliber.
Designed and developed the multi-page web platform from the ground up, with dedicated portals for hospital takeovers, staffing, and compliance audits.

Engineered 'AMRI', a custom healthcare assistant chatbot that guides visitors through tailored service requests, automatically syncing inquiries and contact data into Google Sheets in real-time, backed by one-tap WhatsApp integration for instantaneous doctor and executive consultations.

features.title: Automated Lead Sync to Sheets
features.desc: Inbound hospital inquiries are verified, classified, and written to Google Sheets within milliseconds with zero manual data entry.

features.title: AMRI Interactive Chatbot
features.desc: Intelligent multi-step conversation flow qualifying hospital pharmacy takeover, staffing, and purchase rate requests.

features.title: Direct WhatsApp Dispatch
features.desc: Deep link automation connecting prospective healthcare executives directly to verified operations team members.

features.title: Adaptive Multi-Device UX
features.desc: Fluid responsive performance across mobile smartphones, tablets, and wide workstation displays.

highlights: Multi-page enterprise architecture built with React and Tailwind CSS
Custom AMRI conversational agent with real-time Google Sheets backend sync
Seamless WhatsApp Business integration for instant customer contact
Optimized Core Web Vitals with sub-second page loads and high accessibility

title: Carspace
summary: A hybrid e-commerce platform for buying and selling certified used cars, engineered with instant filtering, real-time inventory sync, and installable PWA mobile capabilities.
description: Carspace connects used car buyers and dealerships through an instant, app-like web experience. Listings, search and price filtering are designed to respond instantaneously.
Built as a hybrid web application with Progressive Web App (PWA) offline capabilities, providing an installable mobile app experience without requiring native app store downloads.

features.title: Instant Search & Multi-Filter
features.desc: Sub-100ms multi-parameter search across make, model, price, and mileage.

features.title: Firebase Real-Time DB
features.desc: Live inventory updates when listings are added, sold, or modified.

features.title: Installable PWA Experience
features.desc: Home-screen installable with offline caching and native mobile gesture support.

highlights: Real-time inventory backed by Firebase Firestore
Advanced multi-attribute search and facet filtering
Progressive Web App with zero-install mobile parity

title: D-MART Analysis
summary: An interactive data-analysis web platform that turns raw D-MART retail transactions into intuitive, visual trends and category insights for decision-makers.
description: D-MART Analysis processes massive retail sales datasets and transforms them into an interactive executive dashboard where revenue trends, SKU velocity, and regional performance can be analyzed.
Engineered automated ETL data processing pipelines and intuitive drill-down charts so stakeholders can uncover hidden profit drivers without needing data science expertise.

features.title: Interactive Metric Drill-downs
features.desc: Explore revenue, discount impact, and customer purchase patterns with live filtering.

features.title: Automated ETL Pipeline
features.desc: Cleanses, normalizes, and indexes raw CSV/database records seamlessly.

features.title: Decision-First UI
features.desc: Designed with minimal noise and maximum clarity for retail managers.

highlights: Interactive charts and multi-dimensional drill-down views
Clean, high-performance responsive analytics dashboard
Automated data aggregation pipeline in Python

title: D7 Sports
tagline: Immersive Virtual Reality Sports & Motion Experience
summary: An immersive VR sports experience combining spatial interaction, high-energy motion graphics, and headset-optimized performance.
description: D7 Sports explores how virtual reality can transform athletic engagement — placing the user inside the action rather than behind a screen.
The project pairs spatial 3D environments with dynamic motion design sequences engineered for high framerates and zero motion sickness.

features.title: Immersive 3D Spatial Audio
features.desc: Realistic stadium audio positioning responding to user movement.

features.title: High-Framerate Optimization
features.desc: Locked 90 FPS rendering to ensure smooth, nauseau-free immersion.

highlights: Immersive VR environments built in Unity
Custom motion-graphics sequences
Optimized for smooth headset performance

title: Interior Design Prototype
image: /assets/img/White and Brown Minimalist Interior Desktop Prototype.gif
summary: An interactive 3D prototype that lets clients walk through and customize interior spaces directly in the browser with realistic materials and lighting.
description: This prototype brings architectural visualization into the browser — users can explore a minimalist space in real-time 3D and customize materials, finishes, and furniture configurations.
Built with Three.js and WebGL to push the boundaries of plugin-free web rendering.

features.title: Real-Time Material Swapping
features.desc: Switch wood, marble, and textile textures with instant visual feedback.

features.title: Zero-Plugin WebGL
features.desc: Runs smoothly in standard mobile and desktop browsers with no installs.

highlights: Real-time 3D rendering with Three.js
Interactive material and color customizer
Smooth camera controls and lighting simulation

title: AR Mart
summary: Augmented-reality shopping concepts that bring products into the customer’s physical space at true scale before purchasing.
description: AR Mart imagines retail without physical limitations — items appear in the customer's room via camera preview with realistic scale and occlusion.
Explores the complete buying journey from spatial discovery to instant checkout.

features.title: True-to-Scale Projection
features.desc: Preview furniture and products accurately against room dimensions.

highlights: Web-based AR — no app install needed
True-to-scale product previews
End-to-end shopping journey mockups

title: PricePulse
summary: A price-comparison web application that tracks products across stores so consumers and procurement teams buy at the optimal moment.
description: PricePulse monitors e-commerce prices continuously, analyzing historical trends to identify the best buying window.
The interface delivers immediate value: search any item, compare store prices side-by-side, and visualize price fluctuations.

features.title: Multi-Vendor Scraping Engine
features.desc: Fetches and normalizes live pricing from top e-commerce retailers.

highlights: Multi-store price comparison
Price-history tracking
Clean, decision-first UI
